# Anahita

> Open-source social software that an organisation runs for its own community: people, groups, events, articles, photos, videos, custom feeds and websites, in a chronological feed with no tracking. It speaks ActivityPub (the fediverse) and the AT Protocol (Bluesky). Federation is opt-in for each profile.

Anahita is made for schools, newsrooms, libraries, research groups and non-profits that want digital sovereignty: a social network of their own instead of mainstream, centralised platforms. It is two products: Anahita Services (repository anahita-services), Go services behind one API (OpenAPI 3.1), run with Docker Compose locally and Kubernetes live; and Anahita Web (anahita-web), the React and Material UI web app. Anahita Mobile and Anahita CLI are planned. Source: https://github.com/anahitasocial. Maintained and developed by rmd studio.

## Docs

- [Docs](https://www.anahita.io/docs/): where every part of the documentation lives
- [Anahita Services docs](https://www.anahita.io/docs/services/): running an instance, the concepts (the graph, how things are found), federation, and building on it
- [Why Anahita](https://www.anahita.io/docs/services/why-anahita/): the design principles
- [Anahita Web docs](https://www.anahita.io/docs/web/): getting started, configuration, architecture, customising, deploying
- [MCP server](https://github.com/anahitasocial/anahita-mcp): anahita-mcp, these docs and the API reference for AI agents, run on your computer with `npx -y github:anahitasocial/anahita-mcp`
- [Docs index](https://www.anahita.io/docs/index.json): every page of the docs as Markdown, cut into sections, in one JSON file

## API

- [API reference](https://www.anahita.io/api/): every route, grouped by service
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://www.anahita.io/api/anahita.json): the whole API in one file

## Site

- [Home](https://www.anahita.io/): what Anahita is and who it is for
- [About](https://www.anahita.io/about/): who makes Anahita, its history, and how AI is used in writing the site
- [Blog](https://www.anahita.io/blog/): news; Atom feed at https://www.anahita.io/feed.xml
